units.text: Why Our Team Moved Off Kubernetes After Three Years

Every infrastructure decision feels permanent until the day it suddenly isn't.
We ran 14 services on a managed Kubernetes cluster from 2022 until January 2025.

units.text: The cluster cost $6,200 a month, and two engineers spent about a third of their time keeping it healthy.

units.text: We did NOT move the data pipeline; it still runs on the old cluster until Q3.
